cache_investigation.finding: Godot ShaderRD::_save_to_cache and ShaderGLES3::_save_to_cache open a cache file for writing then report f.is_null() when FileAccess::open fails. This signature identifies cache filesystem IO, separately from the unsupported-shadow error. The logs do not reveal the failing path or OS error, so the specific cause is unconfirmed; no cache or shader project setting was changed.
cache_investigation.possible_local_causes: Permissions, unavailable cache directories or storage/path setup remain possibilities, not verified causes. The shared isolated-storage helper changes the user directory at runtime; this is also a possible capture-environment factor, not a proven project defect.

saved_png_shadow_crosscheck.method: Decoded RGB PNGs as float64 byte values; every other pixel in lower half; separate before/after luminances with weights 0.2126/0.7152/0.0722; ablation increase >2 byte levels (equivalent to >2/255 normalized).
